items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: But yeah, I saw him playing with Jelly Roll.

ctx.x: But John Jelly Roll after Cliff. Cliff wasn't there when I joined him. But yeah, I saw him playing with Jelly Roll.

Did you know Hilaire Andrew? Sure, I knew Hilaire. He was a nice drummer. Where was he from? Here. And who did he play with in Lionhead? Did you know him back then? Well, Hilaire, I believe he played some too with this Jelly Roll.
